entries.text: When I heard you’d requested my coaching\nservices, I couldn’t wait![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.text: I hopped right in one of those chic Flying Taxis\nand had ’em get me here chop-chop.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.text: I’m a little worried my class will overstimulate\nthese kids, though.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.text: But you’ll take the fall for me if anything goes\nwrong, won’t you?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp01_04

entries.text: Glad to hear you’d be my knight in sparkly lip\ngloss! But don’t worry, darling—I was kidding.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.text: Awww. Got you shook with that one, did I?\nDon’t worry, cutie—I was only kidding.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.text: I’m absolutely thrilled you invited me back.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.text: Not many people here know me, but when I tell\nthem what I do, they perk right up.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_03

entries.text: As well-known as the name Tulip is in Paldea,\nhere no one knows me from the next flower.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_04

entries.text: I’ve got to find a way to tastefully bottle the\nsecret to my beauty. I’d love it if anyone in the\r\nworld could just buy the total package![VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp02_05

entries.text: Do you remember the promise you made me,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_00

entries.text: Good on you, holding on to the advice your\nelders give you![VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_01

entries.text: Hmmm. I’ll let you off the hook just this once,\nsince it’s cute that you’re a little forgetful.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_01b

entries.text: When you promised to never fade away, to show\nme how far your talent can go...[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_02

entries.text: I never even dreamed you’d follow through this\nbeautifully! I’m absolutely shook, darling![VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_03

entries.text: You could come work for my company when you\ngrow up, you know. With your talent, you could\r\naim for the very top! I’d hire you—I promise![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.text: Sounds great!

entries.text: I’ll think about it

entries.text: Hehe! I don’t need a final answer just yet.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: coach_gym_esper_sp03_05

entries.text: I think we should do something special to\ncommemorate this new promise I’ve made you![VAR 0x0114(001C)]
